bug: Incident descriptions squeezed to approximately 56px in a 228px phone message area, despite horizontal scrolling.
root_cause: 360px minimum table width plus nonwrapping headings force a narrow description column.
overflow-wrap:anywhere allows words to be split into very short fragments.
The mobile override named markdown-table-scroll does not match the shipped markdown-table wrapper; the generic wrapper already scrolls.
changes: Tables with up to four columns stack as labelled records at message-container widths up to 560px; wide desktop messages retain tables.
Five or more columns retain a scrollable matrix with a minimum readable value width.
Explicit table roles, column headings and aria-hidden repeated visual labels preserve reading structure; each value keeps independent text direction.
Safe Markdown formatting and full source values are retained. No model prompt, API contract, recorded status or receipt data is changed.
Lock background root scrolling while the mobile dialog is open so the outer scrollbar does not reduce the phone viewport.
